description: Search SEC EDGAR for companies by name or ticker symbol. Returns matching company names and their CIK numbers, which are needed for other SEC tools.

query.description: Company name or ticker to search for (e.g., "Apple", "TSLA", "Microsoft")

name: sec_search_companies

found.description: Present and true on an answer; a miss is the found:false branch.

total_hits.description: Total number of matching results from SEC EDGAR

oneOf.description: A miss or an unavailable upstream: found:false with a reason and a hint (the shape check-found-false-schemas.mjs expects).

title: Sec Search Companies
